prose: Lenny Rachitsky's late-2026 tech job market report, his second of the year, finds product managers benefiting most in the AI era while engineering demand stalls and design hits a record low. AI skills are now needed across roles, jobs concentrate in the Bay Area, remote work is at a record low, and the market is growing fast but mostly outside software. Based on two proprietary datasets.
highlights: PMs winning; engineering stalled; design at a record low
AI skills now expected in every role
Bay Area concentration up, remote at record low
